notes:
Straight bridges instead of half circles where wires cross

In tight bundles the half circles ran into each other and the wires
looked like wavy lines. Now both wires stay straight: the more
horizontal one runs on as a bridge, and the crossed wire shows a short
dark gap on both sides of it. Crossings close to each other share one
bridge, so a bus crossing a bundle gets a single one.
